rules: The voice-over drives timing: each section starts at its first clip and the clips are trimmed or sped up to fit.
Speed up waiting (loading, streaming) to 1.5–2x; never speed up typing or hovering moments.
Cut the 2 s still head/tail of every clip except where a hold is useful.
No mention of any hackathon or event anywhere in the video.
Music bed (optional) ducked to -12 dB under the voice; fade in 1 s, out 2 s.
